name: Crocodile
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
effect:
All of your opponent's Characters cannot be removed from the field by your effects.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may K.O. 1 of your Characters with a type including "Baroque Works": Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −10 cost during this turn. Then, you may trash 2 cards from the top of your deck.

official_faq.question: Which player's effects is the "your effects" in "All of your opponent's Characters cannot be removed from the field by your effects." referring to?
official_faq.answer: This refers to the effects of whichever player is using this Crocodile card as their Leader. For example, if this card is your Leader and you activate "EB01-051 Finger Gun", you may use the "trash 2 cards from the top of your deck" effect, but even if you select "1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less", that Character belonging to your opponent will not be K.O.'d.

official_faq.question: If I use this [Activate: Main] effect to K.O. one of my Characters, can I activate that Character's [On K.O.] effect if it has one?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. In this case, the "Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −10 cost during this turn. Then, you may trash 2 cards from the top of your deck." effect would activate first, and then that Character's [On K.O.] effect would activate.
